watches.name: Crossroads - Verbena
watches.description: The Verbena dazzles with shades of purple that dance in the sunlight, just like the star-shaped flower of its namesake. Its chamfered petal texture plays in the light, creating a captivating playscape for the eyes. The deep violet chapter ring adds depth, while the subtle yellow highlights bring a dynamic pop of contrast. Paired with a sleek black strap, the Verbena is a true showstopper.

watches.name: Crossroads - Prickly Pear
watches.description: Inspired by the rugged beauty of the Prickly Pear Cactus, this variant features a lush green dial that mirrors the cactus pads. The sharp chamfered texture reflects light, mimicking the spines of the cactus. Matching the vibrant flowers that the Prickly Pear produces, bright yellow accents cut through the green of the dial, adding an energizing vibrancy. Paired with a rich brown leather strap, the Prickly Pear is rugged elegance at its finest.

watches.name: Crossroads - Lantana
watches.description: The Lantana is a fiery tribute to the beauty that can come from resilience. Its striking orange-red dial, complemented by a deep red chapter ring and bright yellow accents, echoes the vivid colors of the Lantana flower, which is known for its resilience, even in harsh climates. The textured petals radiate outwards, captivating from every angle. Finished with a warm tan leather strap, this model is as bold as it is beautiful.

watches.name: S.O.E. Roadster - Williams
watches.description: The S.O.E. Roadster is a tribute to the brave racecar drivers of the early 1900’s that went on to become spies and saboteurs for the British government during World War 2. Their contributions were massive, and their bravery unmatched. The watch is full of design cues that point to their lives as racers and spies.
